published_properties: Ideonella sakaiensis PETase, from a bacterium living on PET; mesophilic (~30 °C) [Yoshida et al. 2016, Science]. 'Type IIb' PETase [Joo et al. 2018, Nat Commun]. Trp next to the catalytic Ser; W159H makes the active site cutinase-like [Austin et al. 2018, PNAS].

Leaf-branch compost cutinase, metagenome [Sulaiman et al. 2012]. Thermophilic; engineered variant ICCG depolymerised 90% of PET in 10 h at 72 °C [Tournier et al. 2020, Nature]. 'Type I' [Joo et al. 2018].
Thermobifida fusca cutinase, thermophilic actinomycete [Roth et al. 2014]. 'Type I' [Joo et al. 2018].
Thermobifida fusca hydrolase, one of the first PET hydrolases described [Müller et al. 2005].
Saccharomonospora viridis cutinase; Ca2+-dependent thermostability [Kawai et al. 2014].
Thermomonospora curvata cutinase, thermophilic actinomycete [Wei et al. 2014].
Bacterium HR29 PETase, close LCC homolog, highly thermostable [Xi et al. 2021].
Pseudomonas aestusnigri, marine; 'Type IIa' PETase [Bollinger et al. 2020].
Humicola insolens cutinase - a FUNGAL cutinase, PET hydrolysis at ~70 °C [Ronkvist et al. 2009].
